Bettye LaVette qualifies because The Hamilton presents an unusually intimate duo-format evening: LaVette, now 80 and in her 64th year of performing, with only Etienne Stadwijk on keyboards, combining songs and stories across her career. The same stripped-down duo format is touring other venues in 2026, so A+ captures the recommendation better than the scarcity tier S.

events.subtitle: The Songs, The Stories, The Great Lady Of Soul
events.factual_description: The Hamilton Live lists Bettye LaVette for Sunday, October 25, 2026 at 8:00 PM. The exact authorized EVENTIM listing gives doors at 6:30 PM and describes the concert as an intimate evening with LaVette accompanied only by Etienne Stadwijk on keyboards, combining songs and stories from a 64-year career. The same listing notes that LaVette began recording in 1962 and is still performing and making recordings at age 80. Official venue listings elsewhere on the 2026 run document the same duo format, showing that this is a touring presentation rather than a one-night-only configuration.

provenance.note: Date and showtime were verified against The Hamilton Live; the exact authorized EVENTIM listing verifies doors, venue, active ticketing and the announced duo personnel. A separate official venue on the same 2026 run confirms the duo presentation is touring, which informed the A+ rather than S scarcity judgment. Apple Music provides the exact listening destination. Repository search found no pre-existing Bettye LaVette October 25 Hamilton RADAR record before publication.

en.why_it_matters: LaVette does not need a large band to make a song feel rearranged from the inside out. This format strips the evening to her voice and Etienne Stadwijk's keyboards, leaving phrasing, timing, lyric weight and interpretation completely exposed. At 80, after recording since the birth of 1960s soul, she is still working as an active interpreter rather than presenting a museum piece; the small-room songs-and-stories format makes that continuity unusually easy to hear.
en.trip_verdict: Make room for this in the DMV if deep song interpretation and living soul history matter to the listening thread. The duo format is touring elsewhere in 2026, so there is flexibility rather than true one-night scarcity, but The Hamilton is a particularly good scale for hearing the voice-keyboard conversation up close.

es.why_it_matters: LaVette no necesita una banda grande para rehacer una canción desde adentro. Este formato reduce la noche a su voz y los teclados de Etienne Stadwijk, dejando completamente expuestos el fraseo, el tiempo, el peso de las letras y su capacidad de interpretación. A los 80 años, después de grabar desde el nacimiento del soul de los sesenta, sigue trabajando como intérprete activa y no como pieza de museo; el formato íntimo de canciones e historias permite escuchar esa continuidad con enorme claridad.
es.trip_verdict: Vale hacerle espacio dentro del DMV si la interpretación de canciones y la historia viva del soul forman parte del hilo de escucha. El formato de dúo también está girando en 2026, así que hay flexibilidad y no una escasez de una sola noche, pero The Hamilton tiene una escala especialmente buena para escuchar de cerca la conversación entre voz y teclado.
